detail:
The creator says they invest in what they call proper electrolytes. In their experience, most generic brands are low in sodium and high in potassium. The creator claims sodium is the number 1 treatment for POTS because it increases blood volume. That is the creator's claim, not established medical guidance.

The creator personally recommends the brand LMNT, and the creator notes its label lists 1000mg of sodium per serving. This is the creator's personal pick; Tabs does not endorse any electrolyte brand, and Tabs has not verified the label claim.

Tabs is not endorsing or verifying this material. Talk to your doctor before changing sodium or electrolyte intake, since high sodium is not appropriate for everyone.
sourceVideoTitle: Tips I wish someone told me sooner as a young adult living with POTS and MCAS
summary: The creator says they invest in high-sodium electrolytes and claims sodium is the number 1 treatment for POTS. This is their claim, not medical guidance.

title: Choosing high-sodium electrolytes
